'''Reiyosaki Shrine''' (零羊崎神社, pronounced *Hitsujisaki Jinja* or *Reiyosaki Jinja*) refers to two Shinto shrines located in [[Ishinomaki]], [[Miyagi Prefecture]]. Both are considered candidates for the [[Myōjin Taisha]] listed as "Reiyosaki Shrine" in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]].

* [[Hitsujisaki Shrine]] (*Hitsujisaki Jinja*) - Located in Minato, Ishinomaki City, Miyagi Prefecture. Formerly designated as a [[Ken-sha]].
* [[Hitsujisaki Shrine (Mano, Ishinomaki)]] (*Reiyosaki Jinja*) - Located in Mano, Ishinomaki City, Miyagi Prefecture. Formerly designated as a [[Son-sha]].
